core.headline: Guide Price £285,000: Freehold Mid-Terrace, Lordswood, Chatham
core.listing:
An ex-local-authority mid-terrace house with three bedrooms in Fernhill Close, Lordswood, Chatham. Guide Price £285,000. Freehold. No onward chain.

The lounge measures 4.62m x 3.48m (15'2" x 11'5"). The kitchen/diner measures 5.45m x 2.90m (17'11" x 9'6"). There is a lean-to utility. Upstairs, bedroom one measures 3.80m x 3.10m (12'6" x 10'2"). Bedroom two measures 3.30m x 2.95m (10'10" x 9'8"). Bedroom three measures 2.40m x 2.05m (7'10" x 6'9"). The bathroom has a shower over the bath.

The rear garden measures approximately 9m (30ft). There is a gate to a shared rear path. Parking is on-street with no permit required.

Gas central heating is installed. The Worcester boiler was fitted in 2019.

Guide Price £285,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band B (Medway Council). EPC rating C. Construction: Standard – Brick under a concrete tiled roof. Mains electricity, mains water (metered) and mains sewerage. Gas central heating. FTTC broadband. There is a pedestrian right of way along the shared rear path. Damp mark on bathroom ceiling from a cracked roof tile, repaired August 2026, not yet redecorated. Seller unaware of planning or building regulations approval for the lean-to utility.
